notes.title: IT'S TIME TO BEAT QUICK QUEST
notes.content:
Following features to help you beat this game, let's get rid of this frustration and turn it into joy now !

- Arena mode
There is an altar in the hub leading you to a survival arena mode, here arenas structures are different and you can fight against bosses you have seen in the run, and earn some gifts to help you in the next run.

- Hydras corridor replay
Fed up of dying in this Hydras corridor entering the dungeon ? Then this feature is for you, unlock it by arriving to the dungeon in any run. There are also some hearts entering the dungeon now.

- Gifts n' Fairies
play Arena mode and Hydras corridor replay to earn gift for your next run, sometimes you'll even earn a fairy, that can save your run !


Some more stuff :

- up arrow + attack button to throw 2nd gear weapons feature (set on or off in input menu)
- Turkish language localization



Thank you all and enjoy !

notes.title: WALL JUMP+ DEBUGS
notes.content:
Sauter au mur plus haut et plus loin
Particulièrement lorsque vous sautez par des murs en pente,
Affecte également certains casques

- Edition de l'arène du boss
Le mur de la Salamandre Rouge vous permet de sauter plus facilement,
Même chose pour toutes les arènes de boss.

- Débogues :
Le filtre de l'écran reste en place après la pause : pourrait être corrigé
Softlock sur le boss 1 win si vous restez près du mur et que vous glissez sur le sol : corrigé
Problèmes de gamepad : peut-être corrigés ! !?

notes.title: BOSS REPLAY FEATURE, EQUIPMENT STAMINA+
notes.content:
- BOSS REPLAY FEATURE
In the hub room, you can now replay any boss you already beaten in the run, simply by pressing attack button the boss statue (all boss/feat statues are in the left room in the hub by the way ^^)

- EQUIPMENT STAMINA+
Now, when you get damaged, you lose helmet stamina first, and then sword helmet when you have no helmet left (before it was both equipment at the same time, which could be a bit annoying)

- SFX WING FLAP EDIT
the helmet wing flap SFX was a bit rude, edited now.
